enabled.description: Enable controller/PM2 supervisor handling for this RTT instance.

restartOnExit.description: Let PM2 restart the process when it exits unexpectedly.

maxMemoryMb.description: Optional PM2 memory restart limit in megabytes.

unhealthyAfterMs.description: How long runtime signals must stay unhealthy before the controller supervisor can act.

supervisor.description: Optional PM2/controller supervisor guard settings for this RTT instance.

defaultLimit.description: Default row limit for data queries

maxLimit.description: Maximum allowed row limit for data queries

defaultLookbackHours.description: Default lookback window (hours) when no from/to is supplied

maxLookbackHours.description: Maximum allowed lookback window (hours) for raw queries

maxSampleLookbackHours.description: Maximum allowed lookback window (hours) for sampled maxPoints/bucketMs queries

statementTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for QuestDB HTTP requests

maxScanRows.description: Maximum allowed scan rows reported by QuestDB query metadata

maxResponseBytes.description: Maximum JSON payload bytes returned by catch-all endpoint

dataSources.description: Topic scoping for both QuestDB history queries and the MQTT last-value cache. Each entry defines an MQTT topic filter pattern. Topics not matching any entry are rejected. Similar to uns-archiver dataStorage — supports # and + wildcards.

topic.description: MQTT topic filter pattern (supports # and + wildcards, e.g. 'enterprise/#')

tablePrefix.description: QuestDB table name prefix for history queries (optional — falls back to controller mapping resolution)

history.description: Enable QuestDB history queries for topics matching this pattern

cache.description: Enable MQTT last-value cache for topics matching this pattern

default.description: Catch-all UNS data API

apiBasePath.description: Path prefix exposed for the catch-all API (avoid /api to not clash with controller).

swaggerPath.description: Path where the catch-all Swagger JSON is served.

description.description: Swagger description for the catch-all endpoint

swaggerTag.description: Swagger tag shown for the catch-all endpoint

enabled.description: Enable MQTT subscription and in-memory last-value cache for batch queries

topicRefreshIntervalMs.description: Interval for refreshing active topic subscriptions from controller (ms)

staleTtlMs.description: Evict cache entries not updated within this TTL (ms, default 24h)
